ov: رجال بلا ملامح ، فيلم مصري أُصدر عام 1972، من إخراج محمود ذو الفقار، تأليف محمد عثمان، بطولة صلاح ذو الفقار، نادية لطفي.
plotEn: The events revolve around (Ahmed) who just finished his college in engineering. He gets to know the night girl, (Laila), and falls in love with her and tells his father that he'll marry her. But his father refuses as she's not at his social level and threatens him and events escalate.
